story.p1: I-{{full}} yacala ngesikhatsi sekutigcabha. {{founder}} wabona bangani bakhe labasedvute bacala tinkampani tabo, futsi watibonela kutsi kudzinga sibindzi lesingakanani kucala.
story.p2: Leso sikhatsi sahlala naye. Sekuyisikhatsi lesidze atsandza kusita ema-SMME kutsi afinyelele etinjongweni tawo, atfutfuke futsi akhule, futsi abefuna kwakha intfo letawuma nawo nawenta loko.
story.p3: Libito ngumlayeto lebekafuna kuwutfumela kubangani bakhe labasedvute, nakuwo onkhe emabhizinisi netinhlangano letilisebentisako: niyakhona. Chubekani niphusha, ningaze niyekele.
story.title: Indzaba yetfu

about.tagline: I-CRM lehlanganisa libhizinisi lakho, batsengi bakho nelicembu lakho.

hero.body: Kuchuba libhizinisi kudzinga sibindzi, kutimisela nekusebenta kamatima. Kuliphatsa akukafaneli kwente luhambo lube lumatima kakhulu. Sakha emathulusi lalula, lacacile kute ugxile kulokubalulekile: kwakha intfo lenenjongo.

mission.title: Inhloso yetfu
mission.body: Kunika emabhizinisi buchwepheshe lobufinyeleleka, lobetsembekile nalobuhlakaniphile lobenta umsebenti ube lula, bukhulise kukhicita futsi busekele kukhula lokuhlala njalo.

vision.title: Umbono wetfu
vision.body: Kuba ngumlingani webuchwepheshe lotsembekile wemabhizinisi kulo lonkhe leNingizimu Afrika nangale, sisita bosomabhizinisi bagucule emaphupho abe ngemabhizinisi laphilako sikhatsi lesidze.

grow.title: Khula
grow.body: Yakha buhlobo lobucinile nemakhasimende, utfole ematfuba lamasha futsi uchubekisele embili kutsengisa ngekubuka lokucacile kwemphayiphi yakho.

manage.title: Phatsa
manage.body: Gcina umsebenti wakho welilanga nelilanga ndzawonye: emakhasimende, ticalo, ema-invoyisi, imikhicito, imisebenti nemilayeto.

succeed.title: Phumelela
succeed.body: Hlala wati, wente tincumo letincono futsi uchubeke uya etinhlosweni takho. Imphumelelo yehlukile kulelo nalelo bhizinisi; i-YGT ikusita ugxile kuleyakho.

builtFor.title: Yakhelwe emabhizinisi abo bonkhe bukhulu
builtFor.body: Nobe ucala libhizinisi lakho lekucala, uphatse inkampani lekhulako nobe uhola licembu lelikhulu, i-YGT yakhelwe kusekela luhambo lwakho. Emathulusi lanemandla ebhizinisi kufanele asebenteke futsi afinyeleleke, angagcinelwa tinhlangano letinkhulu kuphela.

simplicity.title: Bulula

accessibility.title: Kufinyeleleka
accessibility.body: Emathulusi ebhizinisi lawusito kufanele afinyeleleke kubo bonkhe bantfu.

innovation.title: Kusungula
innovation.body: Sichubeka sitfola tindlela letihlakaniphile tekuchazulula tinselelo telilanga nelilanga.

empowerment.title: Kuniketa emandla
empowerment.body: Sisita bosomabhizinisi bente tintfo ngekutetsemba futsi bachubeke bakhula.

sa.title: INingizimu Afrika lekhanyako, lecinile
sa.body: Bosomabhizinisi baseNingizimu Afrika babhekene netinselelo tabo. I-YGT iletsa emathulusi lasebentako netindlela tekusebenta letifanele emabhizinisi ekhaya, ngato tonkhe tilimi letisemtsetfweni letingu-11, kute uncintisane, ukhule futsi uphumelele emnotfweni wedijithali.

smsSteps.account: Vula i-akhawunti ku-BulkSMS, Clickatell nobe Twilio bese utsenga sikweletu.
smsSteps.keys: Yenta tikhiye te-API kudeshibhodi yemhlinzeki bese utinamatsisela ngentasi.
smsSteps.sender: Engeta i-ID yalotfumelako nobe inombolo levunywe ngumhlinzeki wakho (emanethiwekhi lamanyenti aseNingizimu Afrika adzinga i-ID yalotfumelako lebhalisiwe).
smsSteps.webhook: Gcina, hlola ngenombolo yakho, bese usetha i-webhook URL lekhonjiswe ngentasi njengelikheli le-SMS lengenako lemhlinzeki.

webhookHelp.sms: Kudeshibhodi yemhlinzeki wakho we-SMS, setha loku njengelikheli lemilayeto lengenako (inbound / reply webhook) kute timphendvulo tifike ku-YGT.
webhookHelp.whatsapp: Namatsisela loku ku-Meta: WhatsApp > Configuration > Webhook, bese ubhalisela "messages". Le yindlela timphendvulo tebatsengi letifika ngayo ku-YGT.

channels.whatsappIntro: Xhumanisa inombolo yakho ye-WhatsApp Business nge-Cloud API lesemtsetfweni ye-Meta. Imilayeto iphuma enombolweni yakho futsi timphendvulo tingena ku-Imilayeto.

whatsappSteps.app: Ya ku-developers.facebook.com, yenta i-app yeluhlobo lwe-Business bese wengeta umkhicito we-WhatsApp.
whatsappSteps.ids: Ngaphansi kwe-WhatsApp > API Setup, engeta inombolo yelucingo yelibhizinisi lakho bese ukhophisha i-Phone number ID ne-WhatsApp Business Account ID.
whatsappSteps.save: Kunamatsisele ngentasi, khetsa "Sebentisa i-WhatsApp", gcina, bese uhlola ngenombolo yakho yeselula.
whatsappSteps.token: Ku-Business Settings > System users, yenta i-access token lehlala njalo lenemvume ye-whatsapp_business_messaging.
whatsappSteps.webhook: Khophisha i-webhook URL ne-verify token lokukhonjiswa emva kwekugcina kuya ekuhleleni kwe-webhook ye-Meta.
whatsappSteps.window: Umtsetfo we-WhatsApp: ungaphendvula ngekukhululeka emahora langu-24 emva kwekutsi umtsengi akutfumelele umlayeto; kucala lingcoco emva kwaloko kudzinga i-template levunywe yi-Meta.

dashboard.a1: Tiyagcwala njengobe wengeta tivumelwano futsi ubhala tinkhokhelo. Live lekuphumelela lidzinga lokungenani sivumelwano sinye lesiphumelele noma lesilahlekile.

hero.tagline: Indzawo yinye. Kuphatsa lokuncane. Libhizinisi lelinyenti.

hero.audience: Kwentelwe bahwebi labasebenta bodvwana, emacembu lakhulako netinkampani lesetisungulwe.

data.a: Idatha yenkampani ngayinye igcinwa iyimfihlo futsi ihlukene neyetinye tinkampani, ngekuvumelana ne-POPIA, futsi ungayikhipha nanoma nini.

catering.a: Intsengo yemukelwe: umshado wetivakashi leti-120, R 38 400
catering.help: Yenta sicalo ngemuntfu ngamunye, tsatsa idiphozithi nangabe likhasimende livuma, futsi u-ode kubahlinzeki usuka emsebentini lofanako.

it.help: Landzelela emaphrojekthi kusukela esicalweni sekucala kuya esivumelwaneni lesisayiniwe, futsi ukhokhise i-hosting nelusito nyanga nenyanga ngekutentakalela.

accounting.a: Timali tenyanga tifakwe ku-invoyisi temakhasimende la-14

events.label: Imicimbi nekuhlobisa
events.a: Intsengo yemukelwe: kuhlobisa umcimbi wekuphela kwemnyaka, R 27 000
events.help: Yenta sicalo semhlobiso, tsatsa idiphozithi, futsi utfumele ema-oda kubatsengisi betimbali nebahlinzeki ngaphandle kwekuphindze uthayiphe lutfo.

people.headline: Lwakhelwe emabhizinisi lafana nelakho
people.lead: Noma ngabe uchuba inkampani yekupheka, uphatsa emaphrojekthi ekwakha, unikela ngetinsita tebungcweti nobe ukhulisa libhizinisi lebuchwepheshe, {{name}} igcina emakhasimende akho, kutsengisa nemisebenti yemalanga onkhe ihlelekile.

savings.title: Sikhatsi siyabuya. Imali iyabuya.
savings.year: Loko kungaba tinsuku tekusebenta leti-{{days}} ngemnyaka.
savings.note: Loku kulinganisa, akusiso setsembiso. Kucabanga kutsi wonga cishe imizuzu leli-{{minutes}} entsengweni ngayinye nobe ku-invoyisi longasadzingi kuyithayipha, kuyitfumela nekuyilandzelela wena.
savings.question: Bewungentani ngemahora langu-{{hours}} lengetiwe nyanga nenyanga?
savings.explain: Sicalo ngasinye, i-invoyisi nekulandzelela kutsatsa sikhatsi. Bona kutsi ungonga sikhatsi lesingakanani ngekwenta kuphatsa kwemalanga onkhe kube lula, bese uhambisa emaslayida kute afane nelibhizinisi lakho.

problems.title: Kuyatiwa yini loku?
problems.intro: Emabhizinisi lamanyenti lamancane asebentisa i-WhatsApp, emabhuku ekubhala nema-spreadsheet. Kuyasebenta, kuze kube libhizinisi liyakhula.

leads.problem: Imibuto iyalahleka ku-WhatsApp. Likhasimende libuta inani kodvwa kute lolandzelelako.
leads.fix: Umbuto ngamunye uba likhasimende nesivumelwano ku-pipeline yakho, nesikhumbuto sekulandzelela.

quotes.problem: Ticalo titsatsa busuku bonkhe kutithayipha, futsi ngasinye sibukeka sehlukile.
quotes.fix: Khetsa imikhicito yakho bese utfumela sicalo lesisezingeni lelisetulu nelogo yakho nemininingwane ye-VAT ngemizuzu.

paid.problem: “Kukhokhiwe yini loku?” Uhlola libhange nema-imeyili lamadzala.
paid.fix: Ticalo letemukelwe tiba ema-invoyisi entsela, tikhumbuto tekukhokha titfunyelwa esikhundleni sakho, futsi ungabona kutsi ngubani lokweletako.

scattered.fix: Indzawo yinye yelicembu lonkhe, kunoma nguyiphi ifoni nobe ikhompyutha. Letsa emakhasimende akho usuka ku-Excel.

problem.excel: Imibuto isesipredishithini lokufanele umuntfu asibuyeketeze, futsi leminye isaphunyuka.
problem.crm: Uyayilandzelela imibuto, kodvwa leminye isaphunyuka ngaphambi kwekutsi ibe yimisebenti.

pipeline.fix: Umgca wekutsengisa lokhombisa wonkhe umbuto kusukela emlayetweni wekucala kuze kube ngumsebenti lowinile, kanye negatsi lelilandzelako nelinani lawo.

tasks.problem: Kulandzelela kuncike ku-{{tools}}. Nangabe umuntfu amatasatasa nome angekho, tintfo tiyaphutfwa.
tasks.fix: Imisebenti lenemalanga ekugcina, tinhlu tekuhlola netikhumbuto, leniketwe umuntfu lofanele kute kungabi nalokuncike enkhumbulweni.

documents.problem: Emakhotheshini nema-invoyisi kwentiwa ku-{{tools}}: kubhalwa ngesandla, kunikwa tinombolo ngesandla, futsi kumatima kukulandzelela.
documents.fix: Emakhotheshini lasezingeni lelisetulu ngemaminitsi laphendvuka abe ema-invoyisi ngekuchofota kanye, ne-VAT, tinombolo nelibhendi lakho kwentelwe wena.

problem.rarely: Kukhokha lokwephuzile akuvamile, kodvwa kute lokukubukile, ngako kunye kungahlala tinyanga.
problem.manual: Ulandzela labakhokha sekwephuzile wena, lucingo nome umlayeto munye ngesikhatsi. Kudla emahora netingcoco letingakhululeki.
problem.remember: Labakhokha sekwephuzile balandzelwa kuphela nawukhumbula, ngako imali loyisebentele isolo ingakhokhwa.
problem.automatic: Kukhokha kuyalandzelelwa, kodvwa kumatima kubona masinyane kutsi ngubani lokweledzako malini.

payments.fix: Bona masinyane kutsi ngubani lokweledzako, bese uvumela tikhumbuto letitentekelako tilandzelele ema-invoyisi ladlulelwe sikhatsi.

report.scoreNote: Loku kukala kutsi tinchubo lesibute ngato tihleleke kangakanani, hhayi kutsi ibhizinisi lakho lenta kahle kangakanani. Ibhizinisi lakho lingenta kahle: emaphuzu akhombisa nje lapho tinchubo telilanga nelilanga tingaba lula khona.

attention.label: Kudzinga kunakwa
attention.title: Umsebenti lomnyenti wekuphatsa welilanga nelilanga usencike enkhumbulweni nasemsebentini wetandla
attention.body: Ngekwetimphendvulo takho, tinchubo letinyenti telilanga nelilanga tincike ekulandzeleleni ngesandla nasemathuluzini lehlukene. Leti tikhala lekulula kakhulu kutivala, futsi i-{{name}} yakhelwe loku kanye.

progress.label: Uyatfutfuka
progress.title: Unetisekelo, kodvwa letinye tintfo tisaphunyuka
progress.body: Letinye tinchubo tihamba kahle, letinye tincike enkhumbulweni nasemsebentini wetandla. Kutihlanganisa ku-{{name}} kungakhulula sikhatsi sangempela onkhe tinyanga.

organised.label: Uhleleke kahle
organised.title: Uhleleke kahle. Nyalo kwente kube lula
organised.body: Sewunemikhuba lemihle. I-{{name}} ingabeka tincenye letisele endzaweni yinye, kuze kuphatsa kutsatse sikhatsi lesincane nakakhulu.

high.label: Uhleleke kakhulu
high.title: Tinchubo takho tisesimeni lesihle kakhulu
high.body: Akudzingeki kutsi ushintje masinyane indlela lowusebenta ngayo. Nangabe ufuna konkhe kube ndzawonye, i-{{name}} isengasita, kodvwa sewuvele wenta kahle.

toolsCost.some: Langu-{{loose}} kuwo ngemathuluzi laxhumene kancane kuphela, ngako letinye tintfo tisakopishwa ngesandla: kususwa emaphuzu langu-{{points}}. Tinhlelo letinjenge-CRM noma i-app yema-invoyisi atikubaleli kabi.
toolsCost.manual: Langu-{{loose}} kuwo ngemathuluzi lokopisha imininingwane emkhatsini wawo ngesandla, ngako tintfo tiwela emkhatsini: kususwa emaphuzu langu-{{points}}. Tinhlelo letinjenge-CRM noma i-app yema-invoyisi atikubaleli kabi.
toolsCost.unsure: Langu-{{loose}} kuwo ngemathuluzi langakahlanganiswa, futsi awucinisekisi kutsi yini lekopishwa emkhatsini wawo, ngako tintfo tingawela emkhatsini: kususwa emaphuzu langu-{{points}}. Tinhlelo letinjenge-CRM noma i-app yema-invoyisi atikubaleli kabi.

report.toolsFine: Leli linani lelilawulekako. Kuligcina linjalo kuyasita.
report.noGaps: Kute tikhala letinkhulu letitfolakele. Wente kahle.
report.how: Kulinganisa, hhayi sitsembiso, lokusekelwe etimphendvulweni takho kuphela. Ikhotheshini ngayinye noma i-invoyisi itsatsa imizuzu lengu-8 kuya ku-25 kuye ngekutsi yentiwa kuphi, uma kucatsaniswa nemizuzu lengu-{{ygt}} kuya ku-{{lowYgt}} nge-{{name}}. Kulandzela i-invoyisi leyephuzile ngesandla kutsatsa cishe imizuzu lengu-{{chase}}. Kukopisha emkhatsini wemathuluzi langakahlanganiswa kudla emahora lafika ku-{{switching}} ngenyanga umuntfu ngamunye ethuluzini ngalinye ngemuva kwamabili, kancane nangabe emathuluzi akho axhumene kancane futsi akudli lutfo nangabe ayasebentisana; lokunye kukopisha kuyasala nange-{{name}}. Kubuka tintfo kubalwa ngalokwehlukile, ngako akukho umzuzu lobalwa kabili. Sikhatsi sekubuka sikhula nelinani lebantfu labenta kuphatsa, kodvwa kancane kunaliviyo. Lokuphetulu kwebubanti sikhatsi sakho nyalo kususwa sikhatsi lesilinganiswe nge-{{name}}; lokuphansi kucabanga kutsi udlulisa cishe incenye, ngemizuzu lengu-{{lowYgt}} umculu ngamunye. Lithuluzi ngalinye lelingakahlanganiswa ngemuva kwa-{{ok}} lidla emaphuzu lafika ku-2, futsi emaphuzu asuka ku-0 kuya ku-100.
report.trialTitle: Sewukulungele kwenta kuphatsa ibhizinisi lakho kube lula?
report.trialBody: Sewubonile lapho tinchubo takho tingatfutfuka khona. Zama i-{{name}} mahhala tinsuku letingu-{{days}} ubeke konkhe endzaweni yinye. Akudzingeki likhadi, ungakhansela nanoma nini.
report.worthNote: Ngelinani lakho lelihora. Leli linani lesikhatsi lesikhululiwe, hhayi imali leyengetiwe leciniselekile noma imali lowongayonga. Imiphumela yakho incike ekutsini umsebenti wakho lomnyenti kangakanani lowudlulisako.
report.toolsConnected: Utsite emathuluzi akho ayasebentisana, ngako linani lemathuluzi alikudleli emaphuzu.
report.rangeHigh: Emahora langu-{{hours}} nawudlulisa konkhe loku ku-{{name}}.
report.rangeLow: Emahora langu-{{hours}} nawudlulisa cishe incenye, futsi ikhotheshini ngayinye noma i-invoyisi isatsatsa imizuzu lengu-{{minutes}}.

customers.title: Beka batsengi bakho endzaweni yinye
customers.body: Letsa tonkhe tinombolo, ema-imeyili nemlandvo eluhlwini lunye wonkhe umuntfu langaseshamo, esikhundleni semafoni, tingcoco netincwadzi tekubhala.

pipeline.title: Bhala phansi yonkhe imibuto
pipeline.body: Nika umbuto ngamunye sigaba nesinyatselo lesilandzelako ngelilanga lofika ngalo, kuze kungabi khona lotfulako ungaboni.

tasks.title: Nika konkhe kulandzelela lilanga nemnikati
tasks.body: Susa imisebenti enkhumbulweni nasetingcocweni, uyifake eluhlwini lunye lolunemalanga ekugcina netikhumbuto.

documents.title: Yenta emakhotheshini afane
documents.body: Sebentisa imikhicito, emanani nemininingwane yebatsengi lelondvolotiwe, kuze ikhotheshini ngayinye ibukeke ngendlela lefanako futsi ibe yi-invoyisi ngaphandle kwekubhala kabusha.

payments.title: Misa umkhuba wetikhumbuto
payments.body: Buka onkhe emaviki kutsi ngubani lokukweletako bese utfumela tikhumbuto ngeluhlelo lolungagucuki, kuze kulandzela kungencikanga ekukhumbuleni.

roadmap.footer: Akudzingeki ulungise konkhe ngesikhatsi sinye. Cala ngesinyatselo 1.

plan.whySeats_other: Kukhokhwa ngemuntfu ngamunye, kubantfu labangu-{{count}} labangakusebentisa, futsi kushibhile ngesihlalo ngasinye emaviyweni.

prospects.name: Libito noma libito lebhizinisi
prospects.addNote: Batsengi labangaba khona abayitfoli imikhankaso yakho baze bavume kuva kuwe.
prospects.lawNote: Umtsetfo waseNingizimu Afrika (i-POPIA) ukuvumela kutsi utfumele kumaketha kubatsengi labangaba khona kuphela nasebavumile. Maka "Uvumile kumaketha" nangabe umuntfu atsi yebo, noma utfumele simemo sasikhatsi sinye kute ubabute. Bonkhe labavumako bajoyina tilaleli temikhankaso yakho.
prospects.emptyHint: Engeta bantfu nemabhizinisi lofuna kuwazuza. Batsengi labangaba khona labavela epayipini yakho nase-Discovery nabo bavela lapha.
prospects.invitedOn: Simemo sitfunyelwe nga-{{date}}. Silindze imphendvulo yabo.
prospects.declinedHint: Batsite cha noma batikhiphile, ngako ngeke batfole ema-imeyili ekumaketha.
prospects.agreeIntro: Bhala kutsi {{name}} uvume njani kuva kuwe. Kucacise: bufakazi bakho nangabe umuntfu abuta.
prospects.howAgreedHint: Sibonelo: utsite yebo ngelucingo nga-29 Imphala.
prospects.inviteMessage:
Sawubona {name},

Ngikubhalela ngivela ku-{{company}}. Singatsandza kwabelana nawe ngetindzaba letisitako, emacebiso netipho ngetikhatsi letitsite.

prospects.messageHint: Sebentisa {name} egameni labo lekucala. Buta kutsi bangatsandza yini kuva kuwe, ugcine tipho kuze batsi yebo.
